An undefined SyncReaction (table 5-108) is rejected by the client: error, the configuration is not sent.
A value changed back to 0 stays 0: the RC leaves out trailing zero bytes of the response, the write block must not take the values of its previous response (ST-FIX F100).
A write block used twice: the second (shortened) response does not keep the values of the first one (ST-FIX F100).
The count check (RC has more elements than the PLC array) runs after the initialization with the configuration of this enable - not with the modes and RC data of the previous one (ST-FIX F102).

The load count of the RC is HighestLoadIndex, not HighestToolIndex (ST-FIX F101): an RC with 6 tools and 20 loads does not fit into a load array of 10 (harness C-008: the RC reports HighestToolIndex 5).
SERVER_TO_CLIENT after the start-up: a change on the RC side is read into the PLC data; Synchronized drops and comes back, no warning.
AUTOMATIC after the start-up: the change on the RC side (the most recent change) is read into the PLC data (and written back unchanged, ST-FIX F20, which resets DataChanged on the RC).
CLIENT_TO_SERVER after the start-up: a change on the RC side is overwritten with the PLC data (one write command), the PLC keeps its data.
NO_SYNCHRONIZATION after the start-up: a change on the RC side is neither read nor written, but detected (Synchronized FALSE, spec 5.6.7.3).
